questions.question: Why did God give Israel the land?
options: Because of their own righteousness and their faithful obedience
Because of their strength and their victories in battle
Not their righteousness, but the nations' sin and his promise
Because of their great wealth and their many offerings
questions.answer: Not their righteousness, but the nations' sin and his promise

questions.question: What past sin does Moses recall in detail?
options: The rebellion of Korah and his men

questions.question: Moses fasted forty days and nights interceding for Israel after the golden calf.
Moses told Israel it was not for their _____ that God was giving them the land.
Moses reminded them they had made a molten _____ at Horeb.
